notes.title: Game Update 1 - Bug fixing and changes
notes.content:
So the game has been out for almost 2 weeks and we have released our first bug fixing update and made some other changes.
A big thank you to everyone who has played so far and I hope you all can enjoy what we have planned in the future for this!
Here is a short list of the main fixes and changes we have made:

- fixed a crash when player leaves the caves after collecting enough of the radios.
- Multiple changes to areas within the cave.
- Reduced amount of health character.
- Increased speed of enemies attack slightly.
- Added a way to access the early build of the second map (the map is not finished yet but feel free to explore what has been done... if you can find the access)

There are still a few issues that we are looking into (such as footsteps while jumping... this doesn't happen while playing in the engine but for some reason the built version does.. damn bug) 
Thanks to thyme for pointing out the bugs we have found so far and if anyone else finds anything let us know!
Have an awesome day!

Koyannis Games
